_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_log" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("version"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "gstin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "fssai" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "upi_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "bill_footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "printer_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "connection_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "paper_width" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "mac_address" TEXT NULL, "vendor_id" INTEGER NULL, "product_id" INTEGER NULL, "device_name" TEXT NULL, "ip_address" TEXT NULL, "port" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 9100, "last_connected_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "printable_dots" INTEGER NULL, "chars_per_line" INTEGER NULL, "raster_threshold" INTEGER NULL, "feed_lines" INTEGER NULL, "auto_cut" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_cut" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "print_jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "print_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_role" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_printer_id" TEXT NULL, "source_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "processed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "print_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "job_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "printer_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "connection_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "print_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_success" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_success" IN (0, 1)), "error_message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "details_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tax_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_inclusive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_inclusive" IN (0, 1)), "split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kitchen_stations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES menu_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES menu_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sku" TEXT NULL, "base_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tax_profiles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "food_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'veg', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "available_dine_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("available_dine_in" IN (0, 1)), "available_takeaway" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("available_takeaway" IN (0, 1)), "station_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES kitchen_stations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "prep_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "image_path" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "option_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_select" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "max_select" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "option_choices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES option_groups (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_delta_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_option_groups" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES menu_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES option_groups (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dining_areas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "restaurant_tables" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dining_areas (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "seats" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES restaurant_tables (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "customer_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "customer_phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "guests" INTEGER NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NULL, "staff_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "discount_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "discount_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "cancel_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "client_request_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "order_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "menu_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES menu_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "item_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "base_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_profile_id" TEXT NULL, "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_inclusive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("tax_inclusive" IN (0, 1)), "tax_split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "station_id" TEXT NULL, "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sent_qty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "voided_qty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "order_line_options" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES order_lines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "choice_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_delta_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "station_printers" ("station_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "printer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("station_id", "printer_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kitchen_tickets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "station_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "station_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "round_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "client_request_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kitchen_ticket_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ticket_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES kitchen_tickets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "order_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES order_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "addons_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "bill_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "bill_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bill_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "order_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "customer_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "customer_phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "staff_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "header_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "items_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "service_charge_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "service_charge_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "round_off_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rounding" TEXT NOT NULL, "settings_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_request_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "order_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES order_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "addons_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_inclusive" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("tax_inclusive" IN (0, 1)), "tax_split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_taxes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "base" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "inclusive" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("inclusive" IN (0, 1)), "split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cgst_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sgst_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "igst_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "other_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_print_jobs_status ON print_jobs (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_print_jobs_source_key ON print_jobs (source_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_print_history_at ON print_history (at)
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_at ON audit_log (at)
CREATE INDEX idx_menu_categories_parent ON menu_categories (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_menu_items_category ON menu_items (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_menu_items_sku ON menu_items (sku)
CREATE INDEX idx_option_choices_group ON option_choices (group_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_restaurant_tables_area ON restaurant_tables (area_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status ON orders (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_business_date ON orders (business_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_table ON orders (table_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_orders_day_number ON orders (business_date, order_no)
CREATE INDEX idx_order_lines_order ON order_lines (order_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_order_line_options_line ON order_line_options (line_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_kitchen_tickets_order ON kitchen_tickets (order_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_kitchen_ticket_lines_ticket ON kitchen_ticket_lines (ticket_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_bills_order ON bills (order_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_bills_business_date ON bills (business_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_bills_prefix_seq ON bills (bill_prefix, bill_seq)
CREATE INDEX idx_bill_lines_bill ON bill_lines (bill_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_bill_taxes_bill ON bill_taxes (bill_id)
